predictions.articleTitle: Guadeloupe vs Bermuda Prediction & Match Analysis: Rest Edge vs Relegated Pride — Scoreline Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: Back Guadeloupe for an ordinary Home Win at Stade Roger Zami, backed by superior rest, home continuity, and Bermuda's 15-goal Group 2 defensive concession without Nahki Wells.
possibilityAssessment: Primary Thesis (Core): Home Win — Guadeloupe leverage home venue continuity, 96-hour rest, and a 4-2-3-1 attack led by Claudio Beauvue and Ange-Freddy Plumain against winless, relegated Bermuda (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

Secondary Angle (Value): Over 2.5 Goals & 2:1 Scoreline — Nine of the two teams' ten combined Group 2 games exceeded 2.5 goals, while Bermuda scored in four of five defeats (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Contingency Angle (Hedge / Upset): 2:0 Controlled Home Win — Without Nahki Wells, Bermuda could blank again as Guadeloupe manage a comfortable two-goal margin (Confidence: Low, Value: Low)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Guadeloupe host relegated, Wells-less Bermuda seeking consecutive home wins.

spf.comment: Backed by a projected 2:1 or 2:0 home victory, Guadeloupe hold clear rest, venue, and attacking edges over an already-relegated Bermuda side missing Nahki Wells.

over_under.comment: Although the unadjusted lambda total is 2.25, nine of the two sides' ten combined Group 2 matches reached three-plus goals behind Bermuda's 3.00 goals-against average.

score.comment: A 2:1 repeat of September's meeting reflects Bermuda's concession rate and single-goal counter threat, while 2:0 covers a shutout if Wells's absence blunts visiting finishing.

goals.comment: Three goals aligns with five straight three-plus-goal Group 2 outings for Bermuda, while two goals tracks the unadjusted Poisson baseline peak under a 2:0 home script.

bqc.comment: Guadeloupe led Barbados 2:0 at half-time on Thursday while Bermuda conceded inside six minutes Friday, supporting Win-Win first and Draw-Win if early resistance holds.
